test_clip_int: test the clip function on integer columns with lower and upper bounds in a LazyFrame
test_clip_float: test the clip function on float columns with per-row lower and upper bounds
test_clip_datetime: test the clip function on datetime columns with per-row min and max values
test_clip_decimal: test the clip function on Decimal columns with lower_bound and upper_bound parameters
test_clip_bound_invalid_for_original_dty: test that clip raises InvalidOperationError when bounds exceed the original dtype range
